checks.coverage_rationale: The current router freezes WritingRequest and ReaderIntent, selects one terminal owner, preserves intent conflicts, and binds one whole-artifact composition authority.

The target-owned topology checker preserves LogicGuard, SourceGuard, and TraceGuard semantic ownership through one ResearchGuard console and rejects retired ids, old module commands, direct imports, bare executable routes, and alternate-success paths.
The investigation route binds evidence to a report-level composition profile and validates the actual current report spans for alternatives, limits, conditions, and conclusion scope.
The academic route binds evidence and provenance to an artifact-mode composition profile and validates hierarchy, paragraph contribution, methods, citations, qualification, and actual current spans.
The fiction route owns story movement, resistance and cost, promises and reveals, continuity, point of view, voice, reader-state change, and actual manuscript spans.
The travel route owns traveler fit, guide-kind composition, narrative body, operational appendix, risk, fallback, source recheck, local texture, and actual guide spans.
The shared writing contract binds the complete CompositionPlan and ArtifactMap to the exact current bytes; content findings never become automatic document units.
The current artifact is checked by deterministic audit, route-native semantic review, and an independent judgment bound to real excerpts and exact fingerprints.
Closure consumes one exact current chain and real typed repair attempts; repeated closure calls are not progress and stale evidence cannot close the artifact.

The target evaluator accepts the complete obligation fixture, rejects the exact reader-artifact omission, and compares the current independently scanned source inventory with explicit target semantic rules.
The release projection retains one current v3 entrypoint, current-only contracts, the fixed bilingual route benchmark, portable metadata, and no v1 runtime authority.
The target-owned native check verifies the exact 22-owner model hierarchy, every runner/test binding, and current immutable owner receipts.

claim_boundary: LogicWriting owns the current route-native writing contract and its 22-owner FlowGuard model mesh. SkillGuard supervises declared checks and source closure; it does not claim provider quality or future prose quality.

depth_profile.claim_boundary: SkillGuard supervises the exact current receipts for Logic Writing's declared checks. It does not replace investigation, academic, fiction, travel, specialist judgment, or the frozen repository validation owners.

functions.business_intent: produce a reader-ready investigation, academic, fiction, or travel artifact through one final owner

action.summary: Select one terminal owner and preserve typed specialist authority.
Build current route-native evidence under the selected investigation, academic, fiction, or travel owner.
Translate current evidence into a ReaderBrief and inspect the actual reader artifact.
Derive final closure from minimum route content, current reader evidence, and exact artifact identity.
Calibrate the portable contract and validate its release-integrity boundary.
Preserve the investigation route as a native final-owner route.
Preserve the academic-writing route as a native final-owner route.
Preserve the fiction-writing route as a native final-owner route.
Preserve the travel-guide route as a native final-owner route.
